name: Hardcore Standard Profile
description:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R.-style start.

Replaces the Standard profile with a harsh, low-level beginning: one AKS-74U, one PM, basic gear, and barely enough supplies to survive your first raid.

No free high-tier items. No handouts. Just you and whatever you can scavenge.

If you don’t want something in the starting kit, you can drop it in about 30 seconds — keep 100,000 roubles instead of 500,000, or destroy all of it.

Introducing a friend to SPT? This gives them a starting kit that feels like a real operator’s loadout — not a wall of free guns they didn’t earn.

All other profile presets (EoD, Unheard, etc.) are removed - only Standard remains.

Also included:

VKBO army bag: 4x2 -> 3x4

Waist pouch: 2x2 -> 1x2

How to use? Place the folder here -> X:\Client.0.16.9.5.40743\SPT_Runtime\user\mods

Preview: https://i.postimg.cc/XJ2zHWmw/Hardcore-Standard-Profile.png
